steps.instruction:
質量下降可能來自黏結劑移除或氧化物還原，不可全部解釋成密度增加；用分段秤重資料辨認。
對照「三段材料帳」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。只有金屬質量基準一致才使用守恆縮放；方向差異超出量測散布時改為各向模型。

Mass loss can reflect binder removal or oxide reduction rather than densification; distinguish them with staged weighing records.
Against the nominal Three-stage material ledger result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Mass loss can reflect binder removal or oxide reduction rather than densification; distinguish them with staged weighing records.

steps.instruction:
交付質量基準說明、密度體積表、三軸收縮圖及模型失效條件。
在交接件中加入「三段材料帳」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：在質量守恆前提下連接相對密度與體積，並指出脫脂期間不能直接套用同一質量。

Deliver the mass-basis note, density-volume table, three-axis shrinkage plot and model-breakdown conditions.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Three-stage material ledger: Connect relative density and volume under mass conservation, identifying why debinding violates an unchanged-mass assumption.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Connect relative density and volume under mass conservation, identifying why debinding violates an unchanged-mass assumption. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
